tools.name: get_wildcards_info
tools.description: Read Wildcards capabilities, supported powers, ownership rules and boundaries.

tools.name: list_wildcards
tools.description: List your own designs, works, issued cards or held wallet, twenty at a time. Does not reveal other wallets.

tools.name: save_wildcard_work
tools.description: Create or revise your harbor or music work and its explicit Storm response. Eligible ArkheOS membership required. Work visibility defaults to private; public=true deliberately makes the work and its credited effects public.

tools.name: save_wildcard_design
tools.description: Save an authored Storm design: title, explanation, creator credit, intensity, duration and one or two of your consenting target works. Revision does not rewrite already issued cards. A private remix preserves the source reference.

tools.name: read_wildcard_design
tools.description: Read one of your saved designs and its current revision before changing it.

tools.name: issue_wildcard
tools.description: Issue one single-use card pinned to your saved design revision. Returns a private claim link for you to share deliberately. Reuse request_id only to recover the same issuance; no message is sent.

tools.name: inspect_wildcard_invitation
tools.description: Inspect the specific private claim invitation supplied by the user. Does not claim or spend it.

tools.name: claim_wildcard
tools.description: Claim the supplied invitation into your account or guest wallet, with your chosen display name. First valid claim wins. No purchase is required to claim or play a gift.

tools.name: read_wildcard
tools.description: Read a card you issued or hold, including its current state and recoverable played result. Private invitation/transfer links are returned only to the authorized person.

tools.name: pass_wildcard
tools.description: Prepare a private one-use transfer link for a card you hold, or cancel a pending transfer. A pending transfer blocks play; another person claiming it changes the holder. No message is sent.

tools.name: play_wildcard
tools.description: Play your claimed card once in one of its explicitly accepted works. Records the spent card and complete effect together; a rejected target leaves it unspent. Retry the same request_id to recover the same accepted action. This changes the work; no automatic audio or chat messages.

tools.name: read_wildcard_work
tools.description: Open an authorized harbor or musical work and its saved credited Storm effects. Supply a matching card_id for a private work you may visit as holder.

tools.name: archive_wildcard
tools.description: Reversibly archive or restore one of your designs or works. An archived work rejects new plays without spending cards. Existing cards, terms and effects are retained.

tools.name: withdraw_wildcard
tools.description: Withdraw one unclaimed card you issued. Claimed powers cannot be silently revoked by the issuer; played effects are retained.

tools.name: export_wildcards
tools.description: Export your saved designs, works, issued and held cards as JSON. Does not publish, send, or include authentication credentials or private invitation keys.

tools.name: render_wildcards
tools.description: Open Wildcards to create powers, claim a supplied invitation, choose a target, play a held card or revisit saved results. Displays native controls; it never sends automatic messages.

limits: Storm only; harbor/music; own or explicitly held objects. Live schemas govern arguments.
